summary: Reviewed Message/Interrupt acceptance and console improvements are merged in PRs #18–19. Integrated main 78f84fc passes build/typechecks, 183 Node, 17 queue, 42 simulator and 24 Chromium checks; its tree matches the locally tested combination. Refused messages retain drafts. Fidelity remains Partial: task transfer, approval contracts, pending locks and console theme/mobile work remain. Persistence runtime/history/resume and M1–M4 acceptance are unfinished; earlier paid/hosting evidence retains its original scope.

items.title: Five-agent console
items.notes: React dashboard, orchestration, streaming, virtual workspace and human approval.

items.title: Runtime correctness
items.notes: Revision-bound evidence, permissions, cancellation, restart isolation and reported usage.

items.title: OpenAI Responses provider
items.notes: Opt-in provider; validated calls, continuation and usage. All workspace operations remain simulated.

items.title: Regression suite and CI
items.notes: Integrated main 78f84fc passes build/typechecks, 183 Node, 17 queue, 42 simulator and 24 Chromium checks in CI. The identical local candidate passes every gate. Message/Interrupt refusal and activity/shortcut regressions preserve strict held-body logout/expiry authorization.

items.title: Offline browser acceptance
items.notes: All 24 production Chromium checks pass locally and in main CI with mock agents. Real backend 409 proof retains the original draft, shows an error, prevents human append/automatic retry and permits a later explicit accepted send. Controls/token keyboard and touch proof is included; console dark-mode/mobile limits remain in fidelity.

items.title: Visual progress document and controls
items.notes: Standalone status records merged command acceptance and console improvements with exact combined product evidence. Stable IDs, historical dates and 14 Complete/11 Remaining counts are preserved. Responsive light/dark progress-page proof is separate from the limited console presentation proof.

items.title: Roadmap and status reconciliation
items.notes: Roadmap and ledger record merged auth #15, storage module #13, queue repair #16, command acceptance #18 and console improvements #19. M1 paid acceptance, remaining M2 controls/recovery, real repository M3 and deployment M4 retain separate incomplete gates.

items.title: Real model acceptance runner
items.notes: Preflight and explicit two-run execution, gate validation, budget stops, cancellation and private reports. Twelve offline regressions pass; live acceptance remains pending.

items.title: Useful paid model proposal
items.notes: One gpt-5.6-sol request proposed the Snapshot feature for $0.113582 against a $0.50 allowance. No retries. Not full M1 acceptance.

items.title: Current run Snapshot export
items.notes: Fresh JSON download, all public log lines, no run mutation, duplicate protection, timeout and visible errors. Unit, CI production build and mock browser checks pass.

items.title: Durable executor communication queue
items.notes: Private SQLite assignments, leases, immutable reports/decisions and restart cursor. PR #16 fixes leading-dash lease arguments in callers/examples; 17 offline protocol tests pass on integrated main, including deterministic dash-token renew/report and separate worker processes.

items.title: Registered executor wakeup acceptance
items.notes: Native Codex claim/report/follow-up cycles and local verification subagent report/follow-up claim are verified. The optional local transport records collaboration identity and omits inherited native thread IDs. Claude cloud cannot access this Mac-local queue; no cloud bridge or sleeping external launcher is provided.

items.title: Provider access and spending limits
items.notes: Provider access confirmed Sep 8 with one authorized gpt-5.6-sol request at $0.113582. Further runs require explicit budgets and the intended runner environment; the single-call allowance does not authorize them.

items.title: Hosting decision
items.notes: Sep 8 integration sweep: GitHub returned no deployment records. Other hosting/provider state remains unverified; this does not prove no hosting exists.

items.title: Real model acceptance
items.notes: Runner verified offline and one useful paid proposal completed. Two consecutive five-agent OpenAI passes remain pending explicit budgets and runner configuration.

items.title: Budget ceiling assurance
items.notes: Reported usage enforcement exists; in-flight calls can overshoot and missing usage remains unknown.

items.title: Persistent runs and restart recovery
items.notes: Reviewed module PR #13 is merged; integrated main now passes 183 Node tests. Storage remains unwired. Runtime serialization, run history, process restart recovery and explicit resume remain pending; V1 checkpoints cannot restore runner/workspace/provider continuation.

items.title: API authentication
items.notes: Reviewed API/SSE/browser auth PR #15 merged as e5dc358 with passing main CI. Protected routes, logout/expiry invalidation and held-body command rechecks are verified; 17 Chromium checks include temporary loopback HTTPS cookies. Deployed HTTPS, accounts and role controls are outside this scope.

items.title: Run history and transcript export
items.notes: Historical run API, picker and historical transcript exports depend on persistent storage. Current-run Snapshot download is delivered separately.

items.title: Browser regression tests in CI
items.notes: Main CI runs all 24 Chromium checks after reviewed PRs #18–19: commands, auth/temporary loopback HTTPS, Snapshot, SSE, activity, unavailable controls, token disclosure and progress views. Browser evidence is retained. Historical-run/recovery and responsive/light console acceptance remain pending.

items.title: Dashboard controls and fidelity
items.notes: Merged #18 delivers explicit Message/Interrupt acceptance, no-effect 409 refusals and retained drafts. Merged #19 adds truthful activity, unavailable Reassign/auto-approve reasons, token disclosure and dynamic PR labels. Atomic task transfer, a real tool-approval contract and pending locks remain. Console evidence is dark mode and retains an 1180px mobile minimum; responsive/light console work is still pending.

items.title: Real repository workspace
items.notes: Isolated files, restricted commands, Git operations, configurable goals and GitHub PR integration.

items.title: Real feature delivery acceptance
items.notes: Prepare sandbox; prove real tests, agent PR, approval hold and human-approved merge.

items.title: Packaging and deployment
items.notes: Container/runbook, persistent storage, secrets, HTTPS and selected host.

items.title: Remote and phone acceptance
items.notes: Verify authenticated deployed dashboard, mock and budgeted real runs; document deployment.
